title: Yummy Flaky Ukrainian Pork Roast
description: This Ukrainian pork roast is a crowd-pleaser, featuring a delicious blend of cranberry juice and wine, and is low in sodium, making it a great option for those with dietary restrictions. The result is a tender, flaky, and flavorful roast that is sure to impress.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together the cranberry juice, red wine, and olive oil.
Rub the garlic powder, salt-free seasoning blend, and black pepper all over the pork roast.
Place the pork roast in a large roasting pan and pour the cranberry juice mixture over it.
Roast the pork in the preheated oven for 20 minutes per pound, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the pork rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Strain the pan juices and serve them alongside the pork.
